_about: Manual links between state bills and City Council dockets, for pairs the title matcher can't make or gets wrong. Key: '<General Court>/<bill number>'. Value: the council docket ('YYYY-NNNN'), or null to say the bill has no council docket. Entries here override automatic matching.
_194/H4924: Council 2025-0145 'To establish the Commission of Inspectors General on Financial Oversight' was passed in a new draft on 2025-10-29; the House and Senate bills filed in Jan-Feb 2026 carry it as the Boston Inspector General Oversight Commission.
